model.face_law: native finite-strain isotropic J2, ideal perfect plastic; no hardening qualification
model.scope: Historical face-only campaign; final regularized model in core_fold

thermal_sensitivity.approach: Separate conservative yield-strength debit using von Mises norm triangle inequality; no thermomechanical prestress field or stiffness simulated

first_yield: First converged integration-point PEEQ > 1e-10, bracketed by last elastic and first plastic increment. Last-two-elastic extrapolation is an estimate only; confirmed boundary checks use target load caps.
endpoint: Last converged monotonic follower-pressure static increment; load-control failure is not a validated collapse load or postbuckling branch. Retain native return code and diagnostics.
RMS: one Gaussian inward offset: delta(theta)=a exp[-(R theta/w)^2]; RMS about prescribed sphere = a sqrt(0.5 integral_0^pi exp[-2(R theta/w)^2] sin(theta)dtheta); small-patch a*w/(sqrt(8)*R). No random-field or multi-dimple interpretation.
reuse: 029 axisymmetric.py explicitly authorized by CARD-047. Original preserved, own modifications in axisymmetric.py. Native runs all admitted by simjob.

sources.title: CalculiX 2.21 manual
sources.use: Native finite-strain plastic law, stress/PEEQ output and material keywords

sources.title: NASA CR-194164
sources.use: nu12 .0768; not validation of a scalar isotropic formed-face law

sources.title: EUCASS2023-367
sources.use: 029 benchmark differs in constitutive law, imperfection, core and solution method; conditional factors only

exact_037b_reoptimized_sensitivity.note: Primary geometry holds the requested 028b point. This controlled sensitivity checks the very small re-optimized 037b geometry, at the same prescribed dimple width.

core_fold.core_law: Orthotropic StVK, zero Poisson; shear-strength stop; unsourced in-plane regularization
core_fold.criterion: min(endpoint,first face yield,first core shear failure)
core_fold.catalog_basis: Hexcel CR III Table II, 5056 3/8 inch / 1.0 pcf; 0.625 inch test thickness
